newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - United Dental started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - United Dental started.

text.p: Dillon, Read & Co Inc said on Friday it started coverage of United Dental Care Inc with a buy rating and a 12- to 18-month price target of $25 a share.
-- Analyst Jimmy Lane said in a research note he projected the company would return to consistent earnings growth in the third quarter, following relatively disappointing results in the first half.
-- Lane set a 1997 earnings estimate of $0.04 per share and a 1998 estimate of $1.04.
